purpose: WP2/WP3: re-establish the Stage V reference for the correct P15 candidate (opt_q100_b0_step0_try0_block) under the new fixed problem-spec domain, one factor at a time: (a) plain fixed-domain grid family, (b) predeclared local wake-refinement family.

fixed_conditions.flow_case: matched_re_laminar: U=(1,0,0) m/s, rho=1.0, nu=1e-2 m^2/s, laminar

union_vs_fixed_domain_note: Every historical Stage V case took its outer box from the geometry union bounds plus padding. For this candidate the union bottom was z=-0.3875 m, only ~0.19 m below the body: the old reference contained an unmeasured ground/interference coupling. Under the declared fixed domain (bottom at z=-0.6) the same candidate's Cd drops from ~3.13 to ~1.63-1.74 and downforce from ~0.82 to ~0.51-0.52. Historical union-box force values therefore must not be compared with fixed-domain values, and P16 drifts measured through V3 on the union box (0.02993) are not transferable.

plain_family_transitions.verdict: bounds_not_met; finest downforce drift improved from 0.02993 (union box) to 0.01291 (fixed domain), 2.3x, but still ~2.6x the registered absolute bound

wake_refinement_family.aborted_precursor: An earlier level-2 wake declaration produced a byte-identical V1 mesh because the plain family's design_domain region already refines its inside at (1E15 2); it was discarded before any refined solver run.

V3_cont.first_attempt: 3000-iteration endTime cap hit (solver_not_converged, force_not_stationary; correctly refused -- the cap-based refusal path worked as designed; residuals at cap: Ux init 2.49e-6, p 8.70e-6)

continuation.restart_lineage: restarted the run from its own written time 3000 fields with endTime raised 3000->6000, all numerics unchanged; the case dir is opt_q100_b0_step0_try0_block/V3_cont

wake_family_transitions.verdict: three qualified levels exist but the registered bounds are still not met

factor_isolation_result.observation: Adding near-wake level-3 refinement at every level moved forces only marginally (V1 DF 0.5139->0.5086, V2 0.5093->0.5048, plain-V2->continuation-V3 vs plain-V3 0.5222->0.5195), while the V2->V3 global refinement transition moves downforce by 0.0129-0.0170 regardless of wake refinement.
factor_isolation_result.conclusion_declared: Near-wake local refinement is NOT the dominant factor behind the residual downforce drift; the drift behaves like a global discretization family effect, not a wake-resolution effect.
factor_isolation_result.predeclared_next_action: steady vs time-resolved comparison on the same (plain V2) mesh before any change to the design formulation, per docs/phase_plan.md WP3.

validation.iteration_cap: plain family endTime 3000 iterations (V3 converged at 2216); wake V3 needed a declared endTime continuation to 6000

claims_supported: The declared fixed-domain reference is executable and profile-qualified at V1/V2/V3 for the correct candidate (numerical).
The finest downforce drift under the fixed domain is 0.01291 (plain) / 0.01470 (wake family), better than the union-box 0.02993 but still above the 0.005 bound.
Near-wake local refinement does not explain the remaining drift.
claims_not_supported: No cross-fidelity ranking claim remains qualified under the new box (all prior ratios were measured on the union box).
P16 remains open; the downforce bound of 0.005 is still unmet.
next: WP3 fallback comparison: steady vs time-resolved on the same plain V2 mesh; then, per stop rules, either accept the measured uncertainty band for the planned 8-candidate ranking experiment or escalate the discretization question.
